ModMetaData.name: Rental Warehouse
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
Run a rental warehouse: store other factions' sealed cargo for fees, defend it from raiders who come to steal it, and raid other factions' independent vault sites.
Requires RimWorld 1.7 and Harmony. No DLC required. Can be added to existing saves; removing it from a save is not supported.
